opportunities.name: Expedia rental car search with filters
opportunities.description: Search Expedia rental cars for a given pick-up location, dates and times, then filter results by capacity, car type or rental company and sort.
steps: Open Expedia and click the Cars tab
Enter the pick-up location and pick it from the suggestions
Optionally set a drop-off location
Open the date picker, choose the pick-up and drop-off dates, then click Done
Set the pick-up and drop-off times
Click Search
Apply filters (capacity, car type, rental company)
Optionally change Sort by

instances.values: Pick-up and drop-off JFK; started at 1119.6s, resumed at 2179.4s; Apr 3–6, 9:00 am–6:00 pm; filters 2–5 passengers and Luxury; opened sort
San Francisco, Apr 8–9, 10:30 am; filters Avis and Economy

opportunities.name: Booking.com flight search and ticket selection
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com flights (one-way or multi-city) with direct-only and a passenger count, sort by fastest, select a flight and choose the flexible ticket.
steps: Click the Flights tab
Choose the trip type (one way or multi-city)
Optionally check 'Direct flights only'
Enter the origin and destination airports for each leg
Pick the departure date for each leg
Set the number of adults and click Done
Click Search
Optionally apply the Direct only stops filter and departure-time filters
Click the Fastest tab
Click See flight on the top result, then Select
Choose Flexible ticket and click Next

instances.values: One way BLR to GOI, 29 Mar, 2 adults, direct only, fastest, departure 18:00–23:59, flexible ticket
Multi-city NYC to TYO on 1 Jun, TYO to DEL on 5 Jun, 1 adult, direct only, fastest, flexible ticket

opportunities.name: Carnival cruise search
opportunities.description: Search Carnival cruises by destination, departure port and dates, then adjust the number-of-guests filter on the results.
steps: On the Carnival homepage, open Sail To and pick a destination
Open Sail From and pick a port
Open Dates and pick a month
Click Search Cruises
On the results, open the Number of Guests filter and set the count

instances.values: Panama Canal, from San Francisco, Oct 2024
Caribbean, no port or dates, guests changed 2, 3, then 4

opportunities.name: MTA planned service changes lookup
opportunities.description: Look up MTA planned service changes for a given route and date.
steps: Open MTA and go to Planned Work / Planned Service Changes
Type the route in Search Routes and select it
Click Select routes
Optionally open Select Date and choose a date
Review the results

opportunities.name: SpotHero airport parking search
opportunities.description: Search SpotHero airport parking for a given airport and date range, and sort the results.
steps: Open SpotHero and choose the Airport tab
Click the search box and pick the airport
Set the parking start and end dates
Click Search
Optionally change the sort (Featured)
